_comment: Frozen retrieval baselines. A drop of more than `tolerance` below `value`
fails CI. Update deliberately, in the PR that causes the change, with the
paired-bootstrap delta in the commit message — never to green a red build.
168-paper corpus, 1,935 ICT queries, hash embeddings, retrieval scoped to
'shipped' tracks whatever Retriever does today and is the config the gate
protects. 'legacy' is a frozen reimplementation of the pre-hybrid scoring
(raw term-frequency cosine + hand-set section prior) kept so the historical
comparison stays reproducible after production moves on.
tolerance is 0.005, not the CI half-width (~0.013): the point estimate is
deterministic, so run-to-run variance is zero and the gate only absorbs
rounding. Verified by breaking retrieval on purpose — disabling IDF costs

leak_guard._comment: Ranking by chunk length alone must not beat random ordering.
